# Dr. Olimjon Tojibayev — Dental Surgeon & Implantologist (Andijan, Uzbekistan)

> Dr. Olimjon Tojibayev (also known as Tojiboyev Olimjon, Тожибоев Олимжон, Тожибаев, Таджибаев) is a premier dental surgeon, implantologist, and orthodontist with 7+ years of clinical excellence practicing in Andijan, Uzbekistan (hosted at Smiles Dental Group, Kanechka). Specializes in tooth preservation, 60-second optical 3D digital impressions without gag reflex, 100% painless two-stage local anesthesia, premium biocompatible titanium implants (99.6% success rate), clear invisible aligners (elaynerlar), and monolithic zirconia crowns.

## Clinical Services Catalog & Guarantees

1. **3D Digital Dentistry & Optical Impressions** (`/services/digital-dentistry`):
   - Fast 60-second intraoral scan replacing messy silicone/putty molds. 0.01 mm precision.
2. **Dental Implantation (Biotitan Implantlar)** (`/services/dental-implant`):
   - Minimally invasive placement, swelling-free computer templates, lifetime manufacturer warranties.
3. **Clear Aligners (Shaffof Elaynerlar)** (`/services/elaynerlar`):
   - Transparent, invisible orthodontic trays for adults and teens.
4. **Orthodontic Braces (Breket Tizimlari)** (`/services/breketlar`):
   - Metal, ceramic, and sapphire brackets for complex bite corrections.
5. **Monolithic Zirconia & Ceramic Crowns (Tsirkon Tojlar)** (`/services/tsirkon-keramika-koronka`):
   - Extreme durability (15–20+ years), natural tooth translucency, precision milling without excessive grinding.
6. **Aesthetic Ceramic Veneers (E-max Vinirlar)** (`/services/vinirlar`):
   - Ultra-thin 0.3–0.5 mm porcelain veneers for celebrity smiles resistant to stains.
7. **Modern Dentures (Tish Protezlari)** (`/services/protezlar`):
   - Byugel clasp, flexible nylon, and lightweight acrylic prosthetics.
8. **Gentle Restorative Care (Og'riqsiz Terapiya)** (`/services/ogriqsiz-terapiya`):
   - Tooth-preserving cavity treatment, microscopic root canal therapy, and painless fillings.
9. **Clinical Teeth Whitening (Tish Oqartirish)** (`/services/tish-oqartirish`):
   - Safe in-office brightening by 6–8 shades with enamel remineralization.
